The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Biitu]] was home to a [[Species/Legends|species]] of '''crop-producing plant'''. Nestled among green leaves, the [[Plant/Legends|plant]] grew a cylindrical crop, yellow in [[Color/Legends|color]]. The native [[Biituian]]s cultivated these plants in large fields and harvested their crops. The annexation of Biitu by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and the subsequent installation of a [[moisture eater]] to remove [[Water/Legends|moisture]] from the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], [[Death/Legends|killed]] off many of these plants. However, an intrepid group of individuals [[Skirmish on Biitu (15 BBY)|defeated]] the Imperial forces and destroyed the moisture eater, providing conditions for the crop plant to grow again.

==Biology and appearance==
This [[Plant/Legends|plant]] had a [[Color/Legends|green]] stalk and green leaves that had folds running down their center. Out of the top of these plants grew a cylindrical, yellow crop, occasionally blighted by darker spots. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] these crops were ready to harvest, the plant was about knee-high on a [[Biituian]], the native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Biitu]].<ref name="Heep" />

==History==
{{Quote|Yes, Artoo. The crops look like they've completely dried up.|C-3PO comments on the effect of the moisture eater on Biituian trees.|<ref name="Heep" />}}
This plant species was found on Biitu,<ref name="Heep" /> an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] in the [[Cassander sector/Legends|Cassander sector]].<ref name="Geo51">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> The native Biituians cultivated this plant in rows forming large fields and harvested its crops in baskets. However, when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established a [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]] [[Fuel-ore processing plant|processing plant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], these crops [[Death/Legends|died]] off as an Imperial [[moisture eater]] drained all [[Water/Legends|moisture]] from the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and caused a drought. Resistance from the Biituian [[Fidge Tadrazan|Fidge]] and his pet [[Chubb]], the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], and the [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Mungo Baobab]] eventually led to the destruction of the moisture eater and the [[Skirmish on Biitu (15 BBY)|defeat]] of the Imperial forces. The Biituians then used captured Imperials to restore their crop fields.<ref name="Heep" />

==Behind the scenes==
This crop plant was created for ''[[The Great Heep]]'', a [[1986]] TV special based on [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars: Droids'']] that was written by [[Ben Burtt]].
